records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Net sales were $521.3 million, an increase of 10.6% from the $471.4 million in the third quarter 2021 and 4.1% from the $501.0 million in the second quarter 2022;

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Gross profit was $217.8 million, an increase of 20.2% from the $181.2 million in the third quarter 2021 and 5.5% from the $206.5 million in the second quarter 2022;

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Net income was $86.4 million, compared to $68.4 million in the third quarter 2021 and $80.2 million in the second quarter 2022;

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Gross profit margin was 41.8%, an increase of 340 basis points from the 38.4% in the third quarter 2021 and 60 basis points from the 41.2% in the second quarter 2022;

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Net cash flows provided by operating activities for the nine months ended September 30, 2022 was $289.6 million.
